Q: How can I let come objects in from the top of the canvas and delete them after they are gone into oblivion? A:

"First problem", yes use a loop in setup() to create 20 RoadLine's, pushing them into roadLines array. You could pass a y value into the constructor. Change draw() to draw all the RoadLine's in the roadLines array at the new y location.

"Second problem", easiest solution, is to keep doing what you are doing. i.e. just move the lines back to the top of the screen. No reason to delete the lines, just reuse them.

Q: Steps to push simple Java REST API to Docker using VSTS CI A:

Try this:

FROM openjdk:8     

RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/app

WORKDIR /usr/local/app

RUN cd /SpringRest/target

COPY docker-spring.jar /usr/local/app/

EXPOSE 8085

ENTRYPOINT ["java","-jar","docker-spring.jar"]
